newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Wednesday's midday briefing would be brought forward to 1145/1045 GMT. He said there were four news conferences scheduled for Wednesday: Commissioner Edith Cresson on European voluntary service at 1200/1100 GMT; Commissioners Edith Cresson, Martin Bangemann and Neil Kinnock at 1220/1120 GMT on EU and space; Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard at 1245/1145 GMT on environment and Commissioner Padraig Flynn at 1315/1215 GMT on the current and future role of the Community in the fight against tobacco consumption.
Vale de Almeida also said Saint-Nicolas would visit the Commission and meet European Commissioner and Helsinki's mayor Erkki Liikanen at 1245/1145 GMT.

Spokesman Jochen Kubosch said the Court of Justice had confirmed the legality of using article 130y of the Maastricht Treaty, which requires a majority vote, to conclude cooperation agreements including clauses on human rights or the fight against drugs. He said the text was available in French in his office.

In answer to a question spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo said the Commission would start negotiating an association agreement with Algeria in March 1997. Coll i Carbo also denied that recent aid for Algeria was destinated to support the government and said the goal was to help structural economic reforms in coordination with the Bretton Woods institutions.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1106: European Commission decides to support economic reforms in Algeria with 125 Million Ecus.
- IP/96/1110: Chechnya: European Commission approves humanitarian aid worth Ecu 2.2 Million.
- IP/96/1111: The Commission approves the acquisition of joint control of Store 2000, S.A. by Ahold and Central De Serveis Ciencies.
- IP/96/1112: The Commission clears the proposed joint venture between Cardo and Thyssen.
- IP/96/113: The European Commission approves the 1996 TACIS democracy programme in favour of the Newly Independent States and Mongolia.
- IP/96/1115: The European Commission approves a series of TACIS programmes for Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Mongolia.
- Speech/96/316: Speech by Commissioner Monika Wulf-Mathies at Carlo-Schmidt award presentation to Jacques Delors.
- Main points of Wednesday's weekly Commission meeting agenda.
- European Economy No 8/9, supplement A, economic trends: Report of the borrowing and lending activities of the Community in 1995.
- Eurostat ECU-EMS information and central bank interest rates No 11-1996.
- Eurostat MEMO: 99 percent of EU firms have fewer than 50 workers.
- Eurostat Statistics in focus; Energy and industry No 1996-32: More than 16 million enterprises in the EU.
- Eurostat Statistics in focus; Economy and finance No 1996-11: Quarterly accounts-second quarter 1996.
